document.abstract: Cameras—At the present time films for television are being photographed with both 35-mm and 16-mm motion picture cameras at the standard speed of 24 frames per second. For production work where synchronized sound is to be used, the camera must be driven at synchronous speed. A number of television stations currently making their own newsreels use commercially available 16-mm professional cameras and associated equipment.
